input.query: How can a browser application recover after the GPU device is lost?
documents: Close the invalid GPU session, request a new device, reopen the verified model and rebuild its GPU resources.
Restart the network router to improve the wireless signal.
Keep using the destroyed GPU device without changing any resources.
